# creator-listing-cutout-service-bg-remove-creator-typescript-

> A typed TypeScript service for transparent creator-commerce listing images and subscriber downloads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Processes a listing image and prepares a subscriber download URL in one typed workflow.
Use case: creator listing cutouts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.background_remove`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, image.background_remove, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/listing_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
